summary: Kamada Ltd. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, announcing the commercial launch in Israel of two additional biosimilars, Ustekinumab-Kamada (Stelara biosimilar) and Enoxaparin-Kamada (Clexane biosimilar), adding to its existing two-product biosimilar portfolio. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed. Management guides approximately $10 million in biosimilar revenue by 2028 and $20-$25 million annually by 2030, with at least 12 products licensed from six partners targeted by 2030. The filing is an ordinary product-launch disclosure, not a special situation; monitor pipeline execution and in-licensing cadence.
